title: Qamirinakan qʼipipa
intro: Jumax mä jach’a fortuna sarnaqäwi nayraqatan sayt’atätawa, qurimpi ch’amampi k’achacht’at jakawi, ukampirus qhiparux taqi khitinakatix akapachan jach’a kankañ thaqhapki ukanakatakix mä amuyt’asiñ yatichäwiwa. ¿Aka jaqix khitïnsa uk amuytʼasmati, uka jaqin sarnaqäwipax tiempon istʼasi, akapachan yänakapax mä jukʼa tiempotakikïtap uñachtʼayi?
clues: Nayax mä jach’a Profetan jaqinakapat jutirïtwa, ukampis jach’a jach’a tukuñ thakhi ajlliwayta ukat t’aqhisiyañ thakhi ajlliwayta.
Allah jupax walja qamir yänak churitu, ukat tesoros ukanakan llavenakapax mä ch’aman tama jaqinakatakix mä jach’a q’ipipunïnwa.
Markajax qamirïtajat jan kusisiñajatakiw iwxt’apxitu, amtayapxituwa, Allah-ax janiw kusisit jaqinakarux munaskiti.
Nayajj jachʼa jachʼa tukusaw akham sista, walja qollqenïtajajj naya pachpan yatiñajata ukat chʼamachasitajatwa juti, janiw Allahan bendicionapakiti.
Nayax jan wali lurawinakat iwxt’apxitu ukat amtayapxituw kunatix Allah-ax churkitu ukampiw Akhira thakhi thaqhañaja, ukampis janiw ist’añ munkti ukat jach’a jach’a tukuñampiw sarantaskakïna.
Qhipharux Allah jupax uraqix nayaru ukhamarak jakañ utar manq’antawayitu, ukat janiw kuna yanapirinakas utjkituti kamachipar jan walt’ayañataki.

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa

verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
